fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Jump Points are equipped with jump packs that grant vertical mobility and the ability to traverse rough terrain that would slow or stop foot and mechanized formations. This makes them valuable in urban fighting, mountainous terrain, and any environment where the ability to bypass obstacles matters more than sustained speed. Equipped with the Clan-manufactured Mauser IIC Infantry Assault System, these warriors carry energy weapons built to Clan standards that outperform their Inner Sphere equivalents in both range and damage output.
